modmenu.descriptionTranslation.takumi_ga: Lets only invited Takumi Launcher players join a private event server, and warns or kicks players when the event publishes a mandatory update.
takumi_gate.kick.no_launcher: Join through Takumi Launcher to play on this server.
takumi_gate.kick.protocol: Your Takumi Gate version does not match this server. Update the instance from Takumi Launcher.
takumi_gate.kick.unavailable: Your access could not be checked right now. Try again in a minute.
takumi_gate.kick.outdated: There is a mandatory update for this instance. Update it from Takumi Launcher.
takumi_gate.update.title: Mandatory update
takumi_gate.update.subtitle: Restart the game to avoid errors
takumi_gate.update.chat: A mandatory update (version %s) was published. Restart the game from Takumi Launcher: players still on the old version will be disconnected in %s min.
takumi_gate.update.chat_now: A mandatory update (version %s) was published. Restart the game from Takumi Launcher.
takumi_gate.update.warn: Mandatory update: you will be disconnected in %s min. Restart from Takumi Launcher.
takumi_gate.client.notice: [Takumi] Mandatory update (version %s) published. Restart the game to avoid errors.
takumi_gate.client.minutes_left: Mandatory update: %s min left. Type /takumi reiniciar
takumi_gate.client.restart_now: Mandatory update: restart now. Type /takumi reiniciar
takumi_gate.client.restarting: [Takumi] Closing the game to update it…
takumi_gate.client.restart_failed: [Takumi] Could not ask Takumi Launcher to restart. Close the game and press Play.
takumi_gate.client.not_takumi: [Takumi] This game was not started from a Takumi Launcher private instance.
